input.query: SELECT platform, doc_type, reject_reason, CASE WHEN month < TIMESTAMP '2025-11-01' THEN 'baseline' ELSE 'recent' END period, SUM(n_rejections) n FROM agg_kyc_reject_reasons_monthly WHERE month BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2025-09-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,4,5 DESC
SELECT version, platform, release_date FROM stg_app_releases WHERE release_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-12-15' ORDER BY platform,release_date
